script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'command', k.command, 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', k.progress_percent, 'progress_message', k.progress_message,
                   'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message, 'line_count', k.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ida_no', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.idaNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.key}}'
           AND k.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS ida_id, g.stock_movement_no, g.item_disassembly_status, g.posted_status, g.organization_id,
       CAST(g.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(g.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR) AS no_type,
       g.ida_v2_job_id AS ida_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('step', p.step_name, 'ref', p.result_ref,
                            'young', (p.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 120 SECOND),
                            'job', (SELECT q.job_status FROM gd_async_job q
                                     WHERE q.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND q.idempotency_key = p.result_ref AND q.is_deleted = 0
                                     ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE {{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}} > 0
           AND p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IDC|{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS ida_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'command', o.command, 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', o.progress_percent, 'progress_message', o.progress_message,
                   'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message, 'line_count', o.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ida_no', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.idaNo')), NULL))) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE {{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}} > 0
           AND o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command IN ('COMPLETE_IDA')
           AND o.correlation_id = 'IDA|{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}}'
           AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_IDA', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'command', x.command, 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', x.progress_percent, 'progress_message', x.progress_message,
                   'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message, 'line_count', x.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ida_no', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.idaNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE {{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}} > 0
           AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command IN ('COMPLETE_IDA')
           AND x.correlation_id = 'IDA|{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}}'
         ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(y.id AS CHAR), 'command', y.command, 'job_status', y.job_status, 'correlation_id', y.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', y.progress_percent, 'progress_message', y.progress_message,
                   'error_code', y.error_code, 'error_message', y.error_message, 'line_count', y.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ida_no', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.idaNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job y
         WHERE y.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND y.is_deleted = 0 AND y.command IN ('COMPLETE_IDA')
           AND y.id = CAST(g.ida_v2_job_id AS UNSIGNED)) AS link_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM gd_async_job r
         WHERE {{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}} > 0
           AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.command = 'COMPLETE_IDA'
           AND r.correlation_id = 'IDA|{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}}'
           AND JSON_VALID(r.request_payload) AND COALESCE(g.stock_movement_no, '') <> ''
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.request_payload, '$.issuedNo')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = g.stock_movement_no) AS issued_by_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM gd_async_job c
         WHERE {{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}} > 0
           AND c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.command = 'COMPLETE_IDA'
           AND c.correlation_id = 'IDA|{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}}'
           AND c.job_status = 'COMPLETED'
           AND JSON_VALID(c.request_payload) AND COALESCE(g.stock_movement_no, '') <> ''
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.request_payload, '$.idaNo')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = g.stock_movement_no) AS completed_under
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_disassembly g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_DSguard.data.idaId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('material_id', CAST(k.m AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(k.b AS CHAR), 'method', i.material_costing_method,
       'fifo', COALESCE(f.n, 0), 'wa', COALESCE(w.n, 0)) AS j
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT jt.m, jt.b FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.costPairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', b BIGINT PATH '$[1]')) jt) k
  JOIN item i
    ON i.id = k.m
   AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.stock_control <> 0
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.material_id AS m, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n
               FROM fifo_costing_history f
              WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND f.is_deleted = 0
                AND f.plant_id = {{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.plantId}}
                AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
                AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
              GROUP BY f.material_id, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0)) f
    ON f.m = k.m
   AND f.b = k.b
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT w.material_id AS m, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n
               FROM wa_costing_method w
              WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND w.is_deleted = 0
                AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.plantId}}'
                AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
                AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
              GROUP BY w.material_id, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0)) w
    ON w.m = k.m
   AND w.b = k.b
 WHERE (COALESCE(f.n, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(w.n, 0) > 0)
    OR (i.material_costing_method = 'First In First Out' AND COALESCE(f.n, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(w.n, 0) > 0)
    OR (i.material_costing_method = 'Weighted Average' AND COALESCE(w.n, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(f.n, 0) > 0)
 ORDER BY k.m, k.b

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('material_id', CAST(k.m AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(k.b AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code) AS j
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT jt.m, jt.b FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.pickPairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', b BIGINT PATH '$[1]')) jt) k
  JOIN item i
    ON i.id = k.m
   AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.stock_control <> 0
   AND i.material_costing_method = 'Weighted Average'
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM wa_costing_method w
                    WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                      AND w.is_deleted = 0
                      AND w.material_id = k.m
                      AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.plantId}}'
                      AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
                      AND (k.b = 0 OR w.batch_id = k.b))
 ORDER BY k.m, k.b

script.code:
SELECT x.j
  FROM (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('t', 'B', 'material_id', CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR), 'location_id', CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR), 'batch_id', '',
               'n', COUNT(*)) AS j
          FROM item_balance b
         WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND b.is_deleted = 0
           AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.plantId}}
           AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
           AND (b.material_id, b.location_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.l FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.balTuplesJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]',
		l BIGINT PATH '$[1]')) jt)
         GROUP BY b.material_id, b.location_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT JSON_OBJECT('t', 'T', 'material_id', CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR), 'location_id', CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR),
               'batch_id', CAST(b.batch_id AS CHAR), 'n', COUNT(*)) AS j
          FROM item_batch_balance b
         WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND b.is_deleted = 0
           AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.plantId}}
           AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
           AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.batch_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.l, jt.b
                                                                FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_DSkeys.data.batchTuplesJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]',
		l BIGINT PATH '$[1]',
                                                                                                             b BIGINT PATH '$[2]')) jt)
         GROUP BY b.material_id, b.location_id, b.batch_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) x

script.code:
SELECT CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS id
  FROM sm_item_disassembly h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.ida_v2_job_id = '{{node:code_node_DSrow.data.jobId}}'
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'item_id', CAST(h.item_id AS CHAR), 'item_code', h.item_code, 'item_name', h.item_name,
       'item_qty', h.item_qty, 'item_uom', CAST(h.item_uom AS CHAR), 'issuing_operation_faci', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR),
       'organization_id', h.organization_id, 'stock_movement_no', h.stock_movement_no,

       g.item_disassembly_status, g.stock_movement_no, g.ida_v2_job_id AS ida_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref

 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_DSguard.data.key}}'
